pages.title: The End Aftertaste
pages.text: Eat Chorus Flower Cake or drink Ender Mint Tea.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Both use End resources; JEI shows their recipes. Reaching the End keeps the campaign’s normal access requirements.

pages.title: Find End cooking crops
pages.text: Dream Berries grow beneath End islands; Ender Mint grows on End Stone. Reach the dimension normally first; the food book does not bypass the campaign.

pages.title: Cook an End dish
pages.text: End recipes use chorus, shulker ingredients, legitimately obtained dragon products and other local resources. This is a distinct recipe branch, not a requirement to cook its entire menu.

pages.title: Eat a dragon egg dish
pages.text: Dragon-egg dishes have special effects. Use the native recipe and tooltip for their real behavior; no undiscovered buff formula is promised.
